items.title: Maple CEO Defends Institutional Push Amid Departures
items.summary: Sidney Powell said the leadership departures concern Maple’s direction, not its loan book, and outlined plans to expand institutional credit and fintech distribution.

items.title: Dormant Bitcoin Wallets Wake Up After 16 Years, Moving $6.9 Million
items.summary: Two Bitcoin mining rewards from September 2010 moved minutes apart.

items.title: MEGA cuts 20% of workforce as former MegaETH Foundation restructures
items.summary: MEGA, formerly the MegaETH Foundation, laid off 20% of staff days after its rebrand and $30 million push into AI inference products.

items.title: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
items.summary: Analysts see no direct link between Nvidia and bitcoin's decline, pointing instead to investor capital headed into Anthropic as well as a broader risk-off move.
